integrity: The proof exhausts smooth-edge and nonsmooth-vertex support cases using the supporting-functional characterization of Birkhoff orthogonality. The bundled exact Q(sqrt(2)) checker certifies all segment norm formulas and endpoint witnesses. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the regular octagonal plane and does not classify all regular polygonal norms. It determines the one-dimensional oriented sum-length range, not the full joint range of the two sum and difference lengths.
title: Exact Birkhoff midpoint interval of the regular octagonal Banach plane
